Features

  • Smart Table Rendering - Automatically converts complex tables to column layouts

  • Media Upload - Upload images, videos, and documents to S3/CDN

  • Batch Processing - Import entire Confluence spaces

  • Document Support - PDFs, Word, Excel, and more

Getting Started

  1. Install C2N Importer

  2. Configure your Notion token

  3. Set up your upload strategy (S3, Cloudflare R2, or local tunnel)

  4. Start importing!
